returning: detail: returns after missing a 4-2 win against the Boston Bruins on Friday, replacing Nesterenko
away.summary: The Ducks (4-3-0) are projected to start Ville Husso in goal. They will have Mikael Granlund return to the lineup after missing the Bruins game, while Ian Moore (lower body), Troy Terry (hip), and Ryan Poehling (knee) are out. Jensen is expected to make his season debut, replacing Helleson on defense.

returning: detail: enters the lineup after being recalled from Hartford (AHL) on Friday
home.summary: The Rangers (6-3-1) are projected to start Dylan Garand in goal. They will have Taylor Raddysh return to the lineup after being recalled from the AHL, while Igor Shesterkin (lower body), Joonas Korpisalo (lower body), and Joseph Veleno (lower body) are out. The Rangers have earned points in seven of their 10 games and have a strong penalty kill.
